card.name: Scattered mixed word endings
card.fires_on: No single word type fits. It fires on the unit " m" after elevation numbers in Hungarian mountain tables, and on odd word endings like "al", "ara" and "omen".

modes.label: Metres after peak height
modes.description: The letter m after a mountain height number in a table of Hungarian ranges.

modes.label: Word endings
modes.description: The ending of a longer word split into parts, in various languages.
modes.example: kan seluruh kepualaun Melayu ini sebagai Malaysia. Ini membawa erti bahawa semua kepualaun ini adalah merupakan satu neg<<ara>> sebelum dipecah-peca

card.plain: No single pattern stands out. It responds to unrelated bits of text, such as metre units in mountain height tables and the closing parts of long words.
